//: Cases for the 'new device joined' rule (PLANS.md P-10). Run by shared/src/newdevices.test.ts, android NewDevicesTest.kt and iOS NewDevicesTests.swift. A list entry carries only the fields the rule reads; each test fills in the rest of the Endpoint, with e2ePubkey 'pk' unless the entry gives one. 'now' is passed to the rule. A 'prev' without 'keys' is a record written before 2026-10-13: it learns the keys and announces nothing for them. 'currentKeyCreatedAt', when given, is passed to the rule as the createdAt of this device's current group key. 'rotateFor' is the ids the owed rotation is for: the key that pays it must name them all. 'removed' is the ids this device removed. 'remove' runs removeDevice (id, now and currentKeyCreatedAt as for 'watch'); 'rotationDeparted' is the ids a key minted for the watch's debt names. 'removedKeys' is the keys of devices this device removed: a device carrying one under a new id is left out of key handoff until its notice is answered. An id a key record cannot carry (empty, over 64 characters) and a repeated id are not owed. 'review' is the first look: the other devices in the first list, answered once. 'vanished' is devices announced as new, never answered, then gone without this device removing them. 'seed' (a watch case) is the device list a build from before the rule cached; it is the baseline when there is no record yet and it contains this device. 'confirmReview' and 'dismissVanished' are the two answers.

watch.name: first list is the baseline and announces nothing
a device that was not there last time is announced and stays unconfirmed
an unconfirmed device is announced only once, and picks up a rename
a device that leaves while its notice is pending is kept as 'joined, then disappeared' and leaves a rotation owed
a list without this device is ignored, so the next good list announces nothing old
a list without this device and no history stores nothing
a new identity (re-paired, new relay) starts a fresh baseline
a device that re-pairs after removal gets a new id and is announced
two devices at once are both announced, in list order, after older unconfirmed ones
a known device whose published key changed is announced as new, and owes a rotation
an unchanged key on a known device announces nothing
an owed rotation survives later lists that lose nobody
a second departure moves the owed rotation to now, against the key current now
a device shown once and then hidden leaves a rotation owed
a departure with no key yet owes a rotation against no key
a device this one removed stays out of the baseline if the relay lists it again, and is announced
a removal the relay honours changes nothing more and the record is kept
the owed ids keep only the newest 32
an id that is owed again moves to the newest end instead of being listed twice
a removed device that comes back and leaves again owes nothing new
over the cap the oldest ids go first, but never a removed one
a repeated id is owed once and an id a key record cannot carry is not owed
a group of one has nobody to check
a list a build from before the rule cached is the baseline, so what appeared since is announced
a cached list that does not contain this device (another pairing) is not used
a cached list is not used once there is a record
the first look follows the list: a rename shows, and a device hidden from the card is reported as disappeared
a device in the first look whose key is swapped is announced as new and leaves the first look
a device that vanished and comes back is a pending notice again, not both
a vanished notice stays until dismissed, through lists that change nothing
a pending device this one removed, then listed again, then gone again is not shown as vanished
only the newest 20 vanished notices are kept
the only device on the card hidden: the card goes and the notice stays
a device on a cached baseline that the fresh list leaves out is reported as disappeared
a browser that re-paired (new id, same key, old id gone) is not reported as disappeared
an id listed twice counts once on the first look
an id listed twice is announced once

rotationDue.name: owed, and the newest key is still the one that was current
another device rotated, with a clock behind this one
a key dated ahead of the clock does not count as a rotation
owed with no key then, and a key now: replace it once
owed but the ring is empty (the first-key election handles that)
a newer key that names the debt pays it
a newer key that names nobody does not pay it
a newer key that names someone else does not pay it
a newer key that names only part of the debt does not pay it
a key that names more than the debt pays it
a key that names the debt but is not newer than the key then current does not pay it
a debt with no ids is paid by any newer key

rotationDone.name: clears the rotation that was read, and the key it was against
keeps a rotation owed by a later departure

knownTo.name: a device the watch has not accepted is left out
a known id with a different key is left out
a record from before keys were kept trusts by id
a device this one removed is left out even when the relay still lists it
a removed device's key under a new id is left out until its notice is answered
a removed device's key under a new id is trusted once the user has said it is theirs (the extension keeps its key when it re-pairs)

remove.name: removing a device records it, drops its notice and owes a rotation at once
with no key yet, no key is named as the one to replace
a second removal joins the debt of the first
this device is never removed this way
removing an id again lists it once
a record from before keys were kept stays without keys
a device the watch never heard of is still recorded
a key already on the list of removed keys is listed once
removing a device from the first look takes it off the card, and the card with it when it is empty
removing one of two on the card leaves the other
removing a device takes its 'joined, then disappeared' notice off too

confirmReview.name: answering the first look clears it and nothing else
answering when there is nothing to answer changes nothing

dismissVanished.name: dismissing the last one clears the list
dismissing one that is not there changes nothing
